title: Memory-Native Non-Terrestrial Networks for Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2607.00029v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) provide ubiquitous connectivity for embodied intelligence (EI), enabling robots in the wilderness to leverage cloud resources or report critical information to remote centers. However, the synergy is nontrivial due to the highly dynamic, resource-constrained, topology-varying, and task-oriented environment. Existing memoryless NTN protocols become inefficient, since the decisions are driven by local channel conditions and instantaneous service demands. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the memory-native NTN (Mem-NTN) paradigm that leverages long-horizon contexts for memory-augmented system optimization. To realize this paradigm shift, we establish a dual-memory architecture that distinguishes between physical memory representing the state of the world and digital memory encoding historical network experience. translated_title: 面向具身智能的记忆原生非地面网络
translated_abstract: 非地面网络（NTN）为具身智能（EI）提供无处不在的连接能力，使身处野外环境的机器人能够利用云端资源或向远程中心上报关键信息。然而，由于环境具有高度动态性、资源受限性、拓扑多变性和面向任务的特性，二者的协同并非易事。现有的无记忆NTN协议效率低下，因为其决策仅由本地信道条件和瞬时服务需求驱动。为解决这些局限性，本文提出了记忆原生NTN（Mem-NTN）范式，利用长时程上下文实现记忆增强的系统优化。为实现这一范式转变，我们构建了一种双记忆架构，区分表示世界状态的物理记忆与编码历史网络经验的数字记忆。我们进一步开发了记忆的获取、压缩、估值、更新与利用等方法。
tldr: 本文提出记忆原生非地面网络（Mem-NTN）范式，通过区分物理记忆与数字记忆的双记忆架构，利用长时程上下文实现记忆增强的系统优化，克服了传统无记忆NTN协议在高度动态、资源受限环境中决策低效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a memory-native non-terrestrial network (Mem-NTN) paradigm that leverages long-horizon contexts for memory-augmented system optimization through a dual-memory architecture distinguishing physical memory (world state) and digital memory (historical network experience), overcoming the inefficiency of memoryless NTN protocols in highly dynamic, resource-constrained environments.
